description: HELIX Closed-Loop 4 Representative Harness Configurations for Differential Evaluation & Sibling Trajectory Distillation

harnesses.notes: Absolute minimal harness. No session management, no shell, no retry. Reflects raw LLM capability without scaffolding. cli_product is null because 'coding-agent.minimal' is a recipe ID only — eval script uses direct OpenAI-compatible API calls with a bare system prompt to emulate this harness.
Single-agent harness with active-leaf context management and event-driven permissions. Represents the standard HELIX baseline with moderate scaffolding.
Hermes session variant with stable multi-turn context builder and Python subprocess shell hooks. Strong session memory enables iterative debugging across steps.
Most feature-rich harness: optimised prompt context, multi-plugin hooks, Bun/Node runtime. Expected to produce the cleanest solutions — its traces form the primary SFT source.
